item.title: TestNG Interview Questions
item.description:
Beginner (Annotations & Basics)

  1. What is TestNG and explain why and where it is required?
  2. What are the advantages of TestNG?
  3. What are the common annotations you handle in your project?
  4. Explain the TestNG annotations in detail?
  5. What is the execution order of TestNG annotations?
  6. Write the hierarchy of annotations in TestNG?
  7. What is the purpose of the @Test annotation?
  8. Do you know TestNG?

Questions with Answers

1. What is TestNG and explain why and where it is required?

Answer: TestNG (Test Next Generation) is a testing framework for Java inspired by JUnit. It is required for advanced test automation, providing features like grouping, sequencing, and data-driven testing.
